item.title: Harry Potter series
item.description: Books: Harry Potter series # Have you ever wondered how it would be to have magic, but you cannot control it? Harry Potter, a 10-year-old boy adopted by the Dursleys, has that problem at the beginng of the book “Harry Potter and the philophoser’s stone”. As (nearly) any kid at his age, he tries to fit in with the others and have fun, which isn’t easy considering the uncontrollable magic part.
